WITH telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
step1 AS (
  SELECT ta.avg_pulse
  FROM telescope_avgs ta, overall_avg_val oav
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse > oav.overall_avg
),
second_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_avg
  FROM step1
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT s1.avg_pulse
  FROM step1 s1, second_avg_val sav
  WHERE s1.avg_pulse > sav.second_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(st.avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse_rate,
  AVG(st.avg_pulse) - oav.overall_avg as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(st.avg_pulse) - sav.second_avg as avg_above_second
FROM step2 st, overall_avg_val oav, second_avg_val sav
